'''TV-94B''' was a [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] that was used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was assigned to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] as a replacement for [[TV-94/Legends|TV-94]]. He oversaw the space battle of the [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|Battle of Kamino]], led personally by Grievous and [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]], [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. The goal of the invasion was to destroy the [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facilities of [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]], halting the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] production of new [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], and retrieve the DNA of [[Clone template/Legends|clone template]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] to unlock new tactical possibilities for the Confederacy. Commanding droid forces from the General's [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|command ship]] while Grievous and Ventress went to complete their mission with the ground forces, TV-94B later retreated with the rest of the fleet when the invasion was a failure due to the efforts of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="ARC Troopers">{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}}</ref>

==Biography==
{{Quote|Status.|TV-94B, ordering a report on the command ship|<ref name="ARC Troopers" />}}
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> during a Separatist attack on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], TV-94B served aboard General Grievous's command ship. He stood by the General's side as he and Asajj Ventress discussed the invasion via hologram on the bridge. When the fleet jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and arrived at Kamino, TV-94B acknowledged Grievous' order to use [[Echo-3/Legends|Attack Formation Echo-3]] to engage the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] blockade. The tactical droid then demanded the status of the command ship, making sure that [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] were raised, adjacent [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|destroyers]] were in position, forward [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] were ready and the [[Trident-class assault ship/Legends|landing craft]] hidden in the fleet's [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|frigates]] were prepared. He then informed the General that all of their ships were ready, and Grievous ordered him to commence the attack.<ref name="ARC Troopers" />

As the space battle continued, Grievous sacrificed his forward frigate transports. This maneuver confused Jedi Master Shaak Ti, and made [[High Jedi General/Legends|General]] Kenobi suspicious. What the Jedi did not immediately realize was that the debris from the frigates was the Separatists key to victory, as it contained the pieces to the hidden landing craft which were to be used in the invasion of Tipoca City. When the debris fell into the planet's ocean below the city, Grievous transferred to one of the frigates, going down with the landing craft to join his ground forces, and leaving TV-94B in charge of his command ship and the rest of the space forces.<ref name="ARC Troopers" />

When the assembled assault craft attacked from the ocean and both General Grievous and Asajj Ventress personally pressed the attack on the city, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] went to the clone DNA room to secure the DNA of clone template Jango Fett while the General and his troops pushed onward, and killed every clone in sight. With the efforts of General Kenobi and General Skywalker, however, the mission was a failure, as Ventress lost the DNA and was forced to escape. She returned to the fleet with Grievous in an escape pod, and TV-94B's ships retreated.<ref name="ARC Troopers" />

==Behind the scenes==
Originally, the Episode Guide on ''Star Wars.com'' claimed that it was TV-94 himself present on Grievous' command ship. Like TV-94, he was also voiced by [[Matt Lanter]].
